mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (product_id, option_id, user_id, quantity, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{optionId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modified_by = #{modifiedBy}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, p.product_name, p.category_name, p.price, p.shipping_price, p.images, p.option_required, po.option_id, po.option_name, po.option_price FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_option po ON c.option_id = po.option_id WHERE user_id = #{userId}
